svg.title: Uruguay study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Canelones; 2: Montevideo vineyards; 3: Maldonado; 4: Colonia; 5: Rivera; 6: Salto; 7: Durazno; 8: Paysandú; 9: San José de Mayo; 10: Rocha; 11: Melo; 12: Mercedes

g.title: 9 · San José de Mayo: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
